def jtype(j):
    if j.get('type'): return j.get('type')
    if j.get('class')=='finger': return 'slide'
    return 'hinge'

joints=[]
def collect(b):
    for j in b.findall('joint'):
        joints.append(j)
    for c in b.findall('body'):
        collect(c)
for b in wb.findall('body'):
    collect(b)

jdata=[]
for j in joints:
    axis=[float(x) for x in j.get('axis','0 0 1').split()]
    rng=[float(x) for x in j.get('range').split()]
    jdata.append({'name':j.get('name'),'type':jtype(j),'axis':axis,'ctrlrange':rng})

acts=[]
for a in root.find('actuator').findall('position'):
    jn=a.get('joint')
    # match ctrlrange from the joint (inheritrange=1)
    jr=next(x['ctrlrange'] for x in jdata if x['name']==jn)
    acts.append({'name':a.get('name'),'joint':jn,'ctrlrange':jr})

# sites
